beginner.method: Five actual techs, paired seeds 1/7/13; two route weapons Lv4 + two legal passives Lv1 = 10 item levels, 0 evolution rewards. Equivalent run level 8 for two-weapon starters, 9 for one-weapon starters. Actual finite HP 4200, no god mode, purchases, healing pickups, wave director or mid-fight choices. Same 100px circular movement policy with radial correction and real movement speed for all techs. This is a controlled dodge/TTK check, not a human clear-rate estimate. Simulation ignores rendering/hitstop wall-time.

lowerGrowth.method: Five actual techs, paired seeds 1/7/13; two route weapons Lv3 + two legal passives Lv1 = 8 item levels, 0 evolution rewards. Equivalent run level 6 for two-weapon starters, 7 for one-weapon starters. Actual finite HP 4200, no god mode, purchases, healing pickups, wave director or mid-fight choices. Same 100px circular movement policy with radial correction and real movement speed for all techs. This is a controlled dodge/TTK check, not a human clear-rate estimate. Simulation ignores rendering/hitstop wall-time.

alpha.method: Actual pre-stage-9 planner snapshot, 16s ordinary / 48s elite synthetic residency, 85% XP collection, real level choices/chests. 3 paired seeds, auto-aim and one explicit focus tap at encounter start. Actual moving boss, patterns, summons, player attacks, collisions and phase changes. Standing high-HP player isolates TTK; this is not survival or human clear-rate evidence. No purchases or mid-fight upgrades. Global HP multipliers unchanged.
